using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef vector<ll> vll;
typedef vector<vi> vvi;
typedef vector<vll> vvll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

class Modulo {
public:
    ll mod;

    Modulo(ll m) : mod(m) {}

    ll plus(ll a, ll b) {
        ll c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll minus(ll a, ll b) {
        ll c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    ll times(ll a, ll b) { return (a * b) % mod; }

    ll pow(ll a, ll b) {
        ll c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) > 0) c = (c * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    ll div(ll a, ll b) { return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2)); }

    ll factorial(int n) {
        ll f = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f = (f * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }

    vll factorials(int n) {
        vll f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        return f;
    }

    ll combination(int n, int k, const vll& facts) {
        return div(facts[n], times(facts[k], facts[n - k]));
    }

    ll combination(int n, int k) {
        return div(factorial(n), times(factorial(k), factorial(n - k)));
    }
};

class FastReader {
private:
    string line;
    int pos;
    bool eof;

public:
    FastReader() : pos(0), eof(false) {}

    string next() {
        while (true) {
            if (pos >= line.size()) {
                if (!getline(cin, line)) {
                    eof = true;
                    return "";
                }
                pos = 0;
                continue;
            }
            while (pos < line.size() && isspace(line[pos])) pos++;
            if (pos >= line.size()) continue;
            int start = pos;
            while (pos < line.size() && !isspace(line[pos])) pos++;
            return line.substr(start, pos - start);
        }
    }

    int nextInt() { return stoi(next()); }
    ll nextLong() { return stoll(next()); }
};

class FastWriter : public ostream {
public:
    FastWriter() : ostream(&cout.rdbuf()) {}

    void println() { cout << '\n'; }
    void println(bool b) { cout << (b ? "true" : "false") << '\n'; }
    void println(int x) { cout << x << '\n'; }
    void println(ll x) { cout << x << '\n'; }
    void println(double x) { cout << fixed << setprecision(15) << x << '\n'; }
    void println(const string& s) { cout << s << '\n'; }
    void println(const char* s) { cout << s << '\n'; }

    template<typename T>
    void println(const vector<T>& v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)v.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) cout << ' ';
            cout << v[i];
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }

    template<typename T>
    void println(const vector<vector<T>>& v) {
        for (const auto& row : v) {
            println(row);
        }
    }

    template<typename T>
    void println(T x) {
        cout << x << '\n';
    }

    template<typename T, typename... Args>
    void println(T first, Args... rest) {
        cout << first << ' ';
        println(rest...);
    }

    void flush() { cout.flush(); }
};

class MathUtils {
public:
    static const double EPS;
    static int compare(double x, double y) {
        if (x + EPS < y) return -1;
        else if (x - EPS > y) return 1;
        else return 0;
    }

    static int binarySearch(int left, int right, function<bool(int)> leftShouldAdvance) {
        while (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            if (leftShouldAdvance(mid)) left = mid + 1;
            else right = mid;
        }
        return left;
    }

    static int lowerBound(const vi& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] < x; });
    }
    static int lowerBound(const vll& a, ll x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] < x; });
    }
    static int upperBound(const vi& a, int x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] <= x; });
    }
    static int upperBound(const vll& a, ll x) {
        return binarySearch(0, (int)a.size(), [&](int mid) { return a[mid] <= x; });
    }

    static ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
        while (b > 0) {
            ll t = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = t;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static ll lcm(ll a, ll b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }
};

const double MathUtils::EPS = 1e-12;

class E {
private:
    FastReader in;
    FastWriter out;

public:
    void run() {
        int t = 1;
        while (t-- > 0) {
            solve();
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        ll kt = in.nextLong();

        if (kt >= n) {
            out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int k = (int)kt;
        Modulo mod = Modulo(998244353);
        vll facts = mod.factorials(n);

        ll ans = 0LL;
        int c = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            ll comb = mod.combination(c, i, facts);
            ll power = mod.pow(c - i, n);
            ll term = mod.times(comb, power);
            if ((i & 1) == 0) {
                ans = mod.plus(ans, term);
            } else {
                ans = mod.minus(ans, term);
            }
        }
        ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));

        if (k != 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
        out.println(ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    E solver;
    solver.run();

    return 0;
}
